subject: StrataCloud partner paper: settlement routing & tax / invoicing redlines
messages:
From: Emily Wong <emily.wong@stratacloud.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@stratacloud.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed partner paper: settlement routing & tax/pass-through questions

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is our partner paper with suggested edits from our legal and finance teams (see attachment). Two items come up repeatedly on our side and I wanted to flag them up front:

- Settlement routing: our marketplace currently routes funds through the marketplace payout engine to sellers; our standard language expects the marketplace to remit net proceeds directly to the seller. We're proposing the seller (Redwood) receive gross settlement and we (StrataCloud) perform pass-through remittances to any tax authorities on behalf of the end customer.
- Tax / invoicing: StrataCloud prefers to remain the billing party on the platform and will issue a single invoice to the end-customer that includes the platform fee and passes through any taxes. Our procurement team is concerned about changes that would force us to rework our billing system.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept: (a) marketplace-led invoicing (Strata issues invoice to customer), and (b) pass-through tax remittance from Strata directly rather than Redwood acting as the remitting party? If not, please let us know what language would align with Redwood's order form/MSA expectations.

Attached: Strata_Seller_Paper_redline_v3.pdf

Would appreciate a short sync if helpful — we can meet Wed or Thurs.

Best,
Emily Wong
Head of Partnerships Operations
StrataCloud Technologies
[Attachment: Strata_Seller_Paper_redline_v3.pdf]
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Wong <emily.wong@stratacloud.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 17:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed partner paper: settlement routing & tax/pass-through questions

Emily —

Thanks for the redlines and the clear callouts. High-level response inline:

- Settlement routing: we typically prefer the marketplace to remit net proceeds to Redwood and let Redwood invoice the end-customer (this simplifies revenue recognition and tax reporting on our side). That said, we realize many marketplaces want to remain the billing party.
- Tax / invoicing: our standard MSA assumes Redwood generates the invoice and is responsible for collecting/remitting taxes for Redwood-delivered services. We can consider a pass-through model only if (1) StrataCloud provides adequate tax remittance documentation and (2) Marketplace contractually agrees to indemnify Redwood for tax liabilities related to pass-throughs.

Next steps I propose:
1) Rachel and Marcus will draft suggested redline language that (a) preserves Redwood's revenue recognition control and (b) allows a marketplace-billing/pass-through approach with indemnities and documentation obligations.
2) We will put proposed language into the Order Form and call out any MSA alignment items.
3) If StrataCloud can confirm they'd accept a limited indemnity and provide 12 months of tax remittance records on request, we can proceed.

Can you share Strata's procurement availability for a 30-min call? Rachel/marcus and I are available Wed 5/19 10–11am PT or Thu 5/20 9–12pm PT.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: none in this message]
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Proposed partner paper: settlement routing & tax/pass-through questions

Kimberly / Marcus —

Put together a draft with three short options for the team to evaluate (attached):

Option A — Redwood invoices end customers (default): marketplace remits net proceeds to Redwood; Redwood responsible for tax collection/remittance.
Option B — Marketplace invoices / pass-through (conditional): Strata invoices customer; Strata remits taxes; Strata must provide quarterly remittance statements and indemnify Redwood for tax shortfalls attributable to marketplace practices.
Option C — Hybrid: platform invoices in countries where marketplace billing is mandatory; Redwood invoices elsewhere.

Key proposed language snippets: 
- "Marketplace shall provide Redwood with certified tax remittance documentation within thirty (30) days of Redwood's written request."
- "Marketplace shall indemnify and hold harmless Redwood from any tax liability arising from the Marketplace's failure to collect or remit taxes on transactions under this Agreement, except to the extent such liability results from Redwood's breach."

I attached KP_Strata_Redlines_draft.docx with track changes for the Order Form and proposed MSA carve-outs. Marcus — please review revenue recognition callouts; want to make sure this won't break our ASC guidance.

-Rachel
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: KP_Strata_Redlines_draft.docx]
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Wong <emily.wong@stratacloud.com>, procurement@stratacloud.com
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Proposed partner paper: settlement routing & tax/pass-through questions

Emily / StrataCloud procurement —

Thanks for the patience while we reviewed. Attached is Redwood's consolidated redline (Order Form + MSA carve-outs) that implements Option B as a conditional pathway, i.e., marketplace-led invoicing and tax pass-through is acceptable subject to:

1) Quarterly certified tax remittance reports from StrataCloud for the prior 12 months (upon request).
2) A mutual indemnity for tax shortfalls where the marketplace failed to collect or remit taxes, with Redwood able to offset amounts against future settlements.
3) Clear routing: StrataCloud will remit gross proceeds to Redwood's settlement account when required by local law; otherwise StrataCloud may remit net proceeds if it provides the documentation set above.
4) Order Form callouts for revenue share and fee flow that preserve Redwood's ability to recognize revenue on delivered services.

If these items are acceptable, please confirm and we will prepare an executable Order Form (I will route to our finance/legal teams for signature). For convenience, here is a proposed DocuSign link to the updated partner paper: https://docusign.net/XYZ-stratacloud-partner-paper

Proposed short call to align remaining handoffs: Thu 5/20 2:00pm PT (I know our timezone math is tight) — let me know if that works for procurement.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: OrderForm_Stratacloud_v2.docx, Strata_Seller_Paper_redline_v3.pdf]
